verdict.rationale: Mailchimp docs gesture at 'Design better emails' and note Gmail's clipping behavior (a real cross-client rendering concern), but the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on the visual editor's template library, personalization/merge-tag system, or explicit cross-client testing tools. Community reports also describe hands-on editor reliability problems (CKText editor failing to load, drag-and-drop builder blocking manual HTML edits), undercutting confidence in a smooth on-brand design workflow. Missing for 10: documented template gallery/reusable templates, personalization token examples, cross-client rendering/testing evidence, and resolution of the editor reliability complaints.
